from common import * if __name__=='__main__': save_source(__file__) import matplotlib matplotlib.use('Agg') import matplotlib.pyplot as plt import numpy as np s=read(BASE/'docs/study-summary.json') names=sorted([n for n in s['primary'] if n.startswith('quantile')],key=lambda n:int(n[8:])) if not names or 'control_old' not in s['primary']:raise SystemExit(0) plt.rcParams.update({'font.family':'DejaVu Sans','axes.spines.top':False,'axes.spines.right':False}) fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4.8),layout='constrained') for ax,key,scale,title in [(axes[0],'net_ann',100,'Top3 x H5 net annualized return (%)'),(axes[1],'net_sharpe',1,'Top3 x H5 net Sharpe')]: vals=[s['primary'][n][key]*scale for n in names];x=np.arange(len(names)) bars=ax.bar(x,vals,color=['#8c9ba8' if n in REUSED else '#246a9c' for n in names]);ax.bar_label(bars,fmt='%.2f',fontsize=8,padding=3) ax.axhline(s['primary']['control_old'][key]*scale,label='Continuous H20 control',color='#b85736',linestyle='--') ax.set_xticks(x,[n[8:] for n in names]);ax.set(xlabel='Equal-count bin number n (grey: prior study)',title=title);ax.margins(y=.20);ax.legend(fontsize=8) fig.suptitle('Old-label H20 / patience50 | five-seed ensemble | historical selection window') fig.savefig(BASE/'reports/label-grading.png',dpi=160,bbox_inches='tight');plt.close(fig) p=BASE/'reports/detail.html';text=p.read_text() for heading,filename in [('五种子合成信号：Top3×H5正式指标','label-grading.png')]: if 'src="'+filename+'"' not in text:text=text.replace('

'+heading+'

','

'+heading+'

') p.write_text(text) print('Figures generated from official JSON; prior-study points labelled.')
